user.title: Connect to E.ON Next
user.description: E.ON Next no longer accepts email and password for API access. Enter your account API key (starts with sk_live_); see the README for how to get it from a signed-in browser session. The key is stored in Home Assistant and used only for read-only data requests.

tariff.title: Tariff and history
tariff.description: Rates are VAT-inclusive and entered in pounds. Your Next Drive Smart cheap period is 00:00–07:00 Europe/London.

data.gas_calorific_value: Gas calorific value (MJ/m³; 0 keeps volume only)

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect E.ON Next
reauth_confirm.description: E.ON Next rejected the stored credentials, or this entry still uses the retired password login. Enter the account API key (starts with sk_live_).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to E.ON Next
error.invalid_auth: E.ON Next rejected the API key, or API access is not enabled for this account
error.login_response: E.ON Next rejected the login request with an unrecognized response
error.meter_discovery: Login succeeded, but E.ON Next rejected the account or meter query
error.no_meters: Login succeeded, but E.ON Next returned no active meters
error.unknown: E.ON Next returned an unexpected response
error.invalid_calorific_value: Enter 0 for volume-only tracking or a calorific value between 37 and 43.

abort.already_configured: E.ON Next Energy Data is already configured
abort.wrong_account: The API key belongs to a different E.ON Next account

init.title: Tariff settings
init.description: Gas conversion uses m³ × 1.02264 × calorific value ÷ 3.6. Enter your bill value (37–43), or 0 to keep native volume. Converted gas kWh and costs are estimates. Converted gas recalculates the configured history window on every update; other tariff changes recalculate 14 days. Older records outside these windows remain unchanged.
